summary: Mr. Arking discusses the custom of lighting Hanukkah candles in the synagogue to publicize the miracle. He also details the specific Halabi tradition of lighting twelve cups of oil in honor of the Nesi'im mentioned in the Torah readings during Hanukkah.
questions: Why do we light Hanukkah candles in the synagogue?
What is the custom of lighting twelve cups of oil during Hanukkah?
Who are the Nesi'im honored during Hanukkah?
How did the Halabi community observe the custom of lighting oil cups in the synagogue?
